questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘TYRE’ is written as ‘70’, ‘MON’ is written as ‘44’. What is the code for ‘FROM’ in that code language?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:-

Add the place value of the word + 2,

TYRE → T + Y + R + E → 20 + 25 + 18 + 5 → 68; 68 + 2 = 70,

MON → M + O + N → 13 + 15 + 14 → 42; 42 + 2 = 44,

**FROM → F + R + O + M → 6 + 18 + 15 + 13 → 52; 52 + 2 = 54,**

Thus, the correct answer is “54”.

questions.question:

Only H is between E and F. F is below E. G is just below F. D is three places below H.

How many pens are between E and D?
questions.solution:
1) D is three places below H.

2) Only H is between E and F. (So, H is not on the top)

3) F is below E.

4) G is just below F.

 
 

 
 
E

 
 
 

 
 
H

 
 
 

 
 
F

 
 
 

 
 
G

 
 
 

 
 
D

 
 
 

So, there are 3 pens between E and D.

Thus, the correct answer is “3”

questions.question:
Select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

13, 40, 121, 364, ?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:-

13 × 3 + 1 = 40,

40 × 3 + 1 = 121,

121 × 3 + 1 = 364,

Similarly,

**364 × 3 + 1 = 1093.**

Thus, the correct answer is “1093”.

questions.question:
After interchanging the given two signs, what will be the value of 11 ÷ 9 – 63 + 7 × 2?

÷ and +
questions.solution:
Given equation:- 11 ÷ 9 – 63 + 7 × 2?

After interchanging ÷ and + then,

11 + 9 – 63 ÷ 7 × 2

11 + 9 – 9 × 2

11 + 9 – 18

20 – 18 =** 2**

Thus, the correct answer is “2”.

questions.question:
In the following question, select the number which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

9 11 5 94

7 9 13 ?

6 5 14 16
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:-

Multiply the first and second digit – third digit of the row;

9 × 11 – 5 = 99 – 5 = 94

**7 × 9 – 13 = 63 – 13 = 50**

6 × 5 – 14 = 30 – 14 = 16

Thus, the correct answer is “50”.

questions.question:
Six boys R1, R2, R3, R4, R5 and R6 are sitting in a row facing towards the north (Not necessarily in the same order). There are three boys between R4 and R2. R4 is not at any of the end. Only three boys are between R1 and R5. R3 is towards the left of R6. R1 is at one of the end. R2 is towards the right of R4.

Which of the following statement is correct?

options.text: R1 is towards the right of R4
R5 is at one of the end
R3 is to the immediate right of R6
R4 is second to the left of R6

questions.solution:
1) There are three boys between R4 and R2.

2) R4 is not at any of the end.

3) R2 is towards the right of R4. (So R2 sits at the right end according to this information)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ee88b8b21eda8e2a5dfbc6bd75cffdb5351daddbc1e9f971040cc2098b82b8a.png] 

4) R1 is at one of the end.

5) Only three boys are between R1 and R5.

6) R3 is towards the left of R6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d364597597b59dfd34992b379f0504acb6e09b87b73a9f4594d9886a72dc2f44.png] 

So , R4 is second to the left of R6 according to the option.

Thus, the correct answer is option 4.
